verdict.rationale: The official Firebase CLI documents bulk import and export of users into and out of Firebase Auth, which is a genuine first-party operation across many items at once. Beyond that, the evidence only shows general data interaction via the CLI and MCP server, plus multi-filter queries, none of which explicitly covers bulk writes, updates or deletes. Missing for 10: documented batched or bulk writes, updates or deletes for Firestore or Realtime Database data; bulk operations exposed through the MCP server for agents; any hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
